In commit "ipc: remove pre-v14 libmultiprocess compat definitions" (7728c739f0da3ed5fde6e1fe9e33ae95b4af3ebe)

Would be good to bump the documented minimum in [doc/dependencies.md](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/blob/7728c739f0da3ed5fde6e1fe9e33ae95b4af3ebe/doc/dependencies.md?plain=1#L40) with this change. Something like:

```diff
+| [libmultiprocess](../depends/packages/native_libmultiprocess.mk) ([IPC](multiprocess.md)) | [link](https://github.com/bitcoin-core/libmultiprocess/tags) | [v14.0](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36817) |
```
